entry_condition: Contract and inventories accepted at frozen base and H6 evidence
required_action: Freeze owners definitions schema decision metrics and guard specifications; bind migration only to a proven canonical database
exit_gate: All ledgers validate and the bound database identity is recorded; otherwise row counts remain UNKNOWN
rollback_policy: Documentation and planning may be revised; no data mutation exists

entry_condition: M0 complete and a canonical database is proven
required_action: Deploy Storage-owned normalized identity placement replica receipt and journal schema plus classifier in observe-only mode
exit_gate: Schema constraints exist and every candidate row is assigned CANONICAL_LOGICAL LEGACY_PHYSICAL_ENCODED or AMBIGUOUS with zero unclassified
rollback_policy: Roll back observe-only code and unused schema before authoritative writes; preserve observations

entry_condition: M1 complete with classifier evidence persisted
required_action: Introduce Storage-owned resolver and migration-boundary reads before writer cutover; route canonical IDs directly and legacy rows only through classified migration resolution
exit_gate: Canonical rows are readable without URI parsing outside Storage and migration boundary; ambiguous rows fail closed; reader parity and error metrics pass
rollback_policy: Re-enable prior readers only for classified legacy rows within the bounded compatibility item; never reinterpret canonical IDs physically

entry_condition: M2 reader resolution is safe for both classified canonical and legacy rows
required_action: Cut over all five inventoried writers: physical producers call Storage begin complete or adopt; ambiguous catalog path retires; reject new physical encoded IDs
exit_gate: Every writer is canonical or removed; physical to logical writers zero ambiguous writers zero unclassified writers zero and new legacy rows zero
rollback_policy: Rollback application writer release only while M2 compatibility remains and no post-cutover canonical row is sent to a physical parser

required_action: Backfill LEGACY_PHYSICAL_ENCODED rows through the restartable Storage adoption saga; retain CANONICAL_LOGICAL rows; quarantine AMBIGUOUS rows
exit_gate: Every non-ambiguous row has verified Storage identity placement and receipt; journal has no in-flight or failed-unreviewed work
rollback_policy: Retry or compensate journal steps; CAS restores an artifact reference only when its original value still matches; never delete adopted or legacy bytes automatically

entry_condition: M4 deterministic backfill complete and ambiguous cases have deterministic repair or quarantine disposition
required_action: Switch Artifact replica references by row lock or CAS from original value to Storage-issued logical ID only after placement receipt verification
exit_gate: Legacy physical encoded active references zero; ambiguous active references zero; referential integrity and reconciliation pass
rollback_policy: Per-row CAS may restore the original reference during the declared rollback window while legacy placement remains; no global database and storage rollback claim

entry_condition: M5 zero-count gates and reconciliation hold for the observation window
required_action: Remove legacy physical interpreters compatibility fallback migration bridge from normal runtime and raw placement projections; enable all nine guards
exit_gate: Temporary compatibility count zero reader physical parsing zero permanent fallback zero dual write zero dual authority zero and all guards GREEN after their RED proofs
rollback_policy: No semantic rollback to dual authority or physical parsing; forward-fix under Storage authority

entry_condition: M6 guards and zero counts remain stable and retention policy authorizes cleanup
required_action: Close journal archive receipts and evidence then delete legacy physical placement only through Storage-owned lifecycle when canonical replicas and retention permit
exit_gate: Journal terminal count equals candidate count; in-flight zero; failed zero; unclassified zero; retained legacy references zero; compatibility zero
rollback_policy: No rollback of identity or authority; restore bytes only from approved backup or replica under Storage lifecycle policy
